Question: The Sophia Amalia was named after the wife of a king that ruled which two countries in 1648?
Thought 1: I need to find out who Sophia Amalia was named after, specifically the wife of a king. Then I need to identify the king and the two countries he ruled in 1648.

Observation 1: Could not find Sophia Amalia. Similar: ['Maria Sophie of Bavaria (redirect from Maria Sophia Amalia, Duchess in Bavaria)', 'HDMS Sophia Amalia', 'Amalia (given name)', 'Sophia Amalia Marschalk', 'James Robbins (shipbuilder)'].

Action 2: Search[HDMS Sophia Amalia]
Observation 2: The Sophia Amalia was a ship of the Royal Dano-Norwegian Navy[4] named after Sophia Amalia, the wife of King Frederick III.. The ship was built at Hovedøen in Christiania under the direction of English shipbuilder James Robbins and was launched in 1650. She was 51.8 meters long and at that time one of the largest naval vessels in the world. She was commissioned by King Christian IV specifically to surpass the British ship Sovereign of the Seas. The ship was manned by a crew of 680 and had an armament of 108 guns, surpassing Sovereign of the Seas by eight guns..
Thought 3: Thought 3: The Sophia Amalia was named after Sophia Amalia, the wife of King Frederick III. I need to find out which two countries King Frederick III ruled in 1648.
Action 3: Search[Frederick III of Denmark]
Observation 3: Frederick III (Danish: Frederik; 18 March 1609 – 9 February 1670[1]) was King of Denmark and Norway from 1648 until his death in 1670. He also governed under the name Frederik II as diocesan administrator (colloquially referred to as prince-bishop) of the Prince-Bishopric of Verden (1623–29 and again 1634–44), and the Prince-Archbishopric of Bremen (1635–45).[citation needed]. The second-eldest son of Christian IV and Anne Catherine of Brandenburg, Frederick was only considered an heir to the throne after the death of his older brother Prince Christian in 1647. He instituted absolute monarchy in Denmark-Norway in 1660, confirmed by law in 1665 as the first in Western historiography. He also ordered the creation of the Throne Chair of Denmark..
Thought 4: Frederick III was King of Denmark and Norway from 1648 until his death in 1670. Therefore, in 1648, he ruled Denmark and Norway.
Action 4: Finish[Denmark and Norway]
